message.content:
I need to clean up ALL remaining Portainer references from the codebase. The Portainer LXC has been deleted and we're replacing it with Pulse + Arcane.

Please do the following:

1. **Remove from all app main.tf files** - Remove the `local.portainer_edge[...]` references and any `portainer_edge_id`, `portainer_edge_key` variables from all the following files:
   - tofu/apps/dashboards/main.tf - Remove portainer_key from homepage_env, portainer_edge references, "Portainer Edge Agent" from firewall
   - tofu/apps/authelia/main.tf - Remove portainer_edge references and "Portainer Edge Agent" from firewall
   - tofu/apps/jellyfin/main.tf - Remove PORTAINER_EDGE_ID/KEY from env template, portainer references, firewall entry
   - tofu/apps/documents/main.tf - Remove PORTAINER_EDGE_ID/KEY from env template, portainer references, firewall entry
   - tofu/apps/immich/main.tf - Remove PORTAINER_EDGE_ID/KEY from env template, portainer references, firewall entry
   - tofu/apps/obsidian-sync/main.tf - Remove PORTAINER_EDGE_ID/KEY from env template, portainer references, firewall entry
   - tofu/apps/monitoring/main.tf - Remove portainer_edge references and firewall entry
   - tofu/apps/media-management/main.tf - Remove firewall entry
   - tofu/apps/network-services/main.tf - Remove PORTAINER_EDGE_ID/KEY from env template and firewall entry
   - tofu/apps/openwebui/main.tf - Remove "Portainer Agent" from firewall
   - tofu/apps/traefik/main.tf - Remove "Portainer Edge Agent" from firewall

2. **Remove from env templates**:
   - tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/.env.tpl - Remove PORTAINER_EDGE_ID/KEY lines

3. **Remove from docker-lxc module**:
   - tofu/modules/docker-lxc/variables.tf - Remove portainer_edge_id and portainer_edge_key variables
   - tofu/modules/docker-lxc/main.tf - Remove the portainer_edge_env resources (local_sensitive_file and filesync_file)

4. **Update autokuma monitors.json**:
   - tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/autokuma/monitors.json - Remove the Portainer monitor entry

5. **Update Authelia config**:
   - tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/configuration.yml - Remove portainer.homelab.rambtech.dev from allowed hosts

6. **Leave these references** (they're just comments/documentation):
   - tofu/ip-registry.tf - "# 100 available (formerly Portainer)" - This is just a comment, leave it
   - tofu/apps/container-mgmt/main.tf - "to replace Portainer" - This is just a description, leave it
   - tofu/modules/common/main.tf - This appears to be old/unused module
   - tofu/modules/common/MIGRATION.md - This is documentation

For firewall entries, just remove the entire line like:
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }

For .env templates that have Portainer vars mixed with other vars, remove just the Portainer lines.

Make sure to not break any syntax - if removing items from lists, ensure commas are correct.

# =============================================================================
# Dashboards LXC - Homepage + Dashy + Glances
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 201
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Homepage API Keys
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "homepage" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "homepage"
}

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from homepage item
  _homepage_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.homepage.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Homepage widget API keys
  homepage_env = {
    portainer_key  = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "portainer_key", "")
    adguard_user   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_user", "admin")
    adguard_pass   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_pass", "")
    immich_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "immich_key", "")
    jellyfin_key   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyfin_key", "")
    jellyseerr_key = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyseerr_key", "")
    sonarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sonarr_key", "")
    radarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "radarr_key", "")
    sabnzbd_key    = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sabnzbd_key", "")
    qbit_user      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_user", "admin")
    qbit_pass      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_pass", "")
  }
}

# Generate the homepage.env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "homepage_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/homepage.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Homepage Widget API Keys
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Portainer: Settings > Access tokens
HOMEPAGE_VAR_PORTAINER_KEY=${local.homepage_env.portainer_key}

# AdGuard Home: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=${local.homepage_env.adguard_user}
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_PASS=${local.homepage_env.adguard_pass}

# Immich: Account Settings > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_IMMICH_KEY=${local.homepage_env.immich_key}

# Jellyfin: Dashboard > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYFIN_KEY=${local.homepage_env.jellyfin_key}

# Jellyseerr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYSEERR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.jellyseerr_key}

# Sonarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SONARR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.sonarr_key}

# Radarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_RADARR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.radarr_key}

# SABnzbd: Config > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SABNZBD_KEY=${local.homepage_env.sabnzbd_key}

# qBittorrent: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_USER=${local.homepage_env.qbit_user}
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_PASS=${local.homepage_env.qbit_pass}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 201
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dashboards Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "dashboards" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "dashboards"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password)
  portainer_edge_id  = local.portainer_edge["dashboards"].edge_id
  portainer_edge_key = local.portainer_edge["dashboards"].edge_key

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure homepage.env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.homepage_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Dashboards"
  service_description = "Homepage and Dashy dashboard applications with system monitoring"

  service_urls = {
    homepage_internal = "https://homepage.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_internal    = "https://dashy.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_public      = "https://dashy.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Homepage", port = 3000, info = "Main dashboard" },
    { name = "Dashy", port = 4001, info = "Alternative dashboard" },
    { name = "Glances", port = 61208, info = "System monitoring API" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f homepage
cd /config && docker compose logs -f dashy
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart homepage
cd /config && docker compose restart dashy
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=dashboards` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["dashboards", "homepage", "dashy", "monitoring"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Homepage route (internal only)
module "homepage_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "homepage"
  backend_url = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "homepage.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.dashboards]
}

# Dashy route (internal + public)
module "dashy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "dashy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:4001"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "dashy.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route (via Cloudflare tunnel)
  public_domain = "dashy.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.dashboards]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "dashboards_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.dashboards.container_id
  container_ip   = module.dashboards.ip_address
  container_name = "dashboards"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-201"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,dashboards"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["dashboards"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["dashboards"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  depends_on = [module.dashboards]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.dashboards.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.dashboards.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.dashboards.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    homepage_internal = module.homepage_route.internal_url
    dashy_internal    = module.dashy_route.internal_url
    dashy_public      = module.dashy_route.public_url
    direct_homepage   = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:3000"
    direct_dashy      = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:4001"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    homepage = module.homepage_route.remote_config_path
    dashy    = module.dashy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Authelia LXC - Centralized Authentication
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 202
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authelia LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 202
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 512
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authelia Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authelia" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authelia"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password)
  portainer_edge_id  = local.portainer_edge["authelia"].edge_id
  portainer_edge_key = local.portainer_edge["authelia"].edge_key

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authelia"
  service_description = "Centralized authentication with TOTP 2FA and OIDC"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authelia", port = 9091, info = "Authentication portal" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Session storage" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Configuration

**Config:** `/config/authelia/configuration.yml`
**Users:** `/config/authelia/users_database.yml`
**Secrets:** `/config/secrets/` (synced from deploy/secrets)

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f authelia
```

**Check auth status:**
```
curl -I http://localhost:9091/api/health
```

**Restart Authelia:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart authelia
```

## ForwardAuth Middleware

Add `"authelia"` to any service's middleware list to protect it:
```hcl
middlewares = ["security-headers", "authelia"]
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=authelia` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["authelia", "auth", "security"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authelia_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authelia"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authelia.ip_address}:9091"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.authelia]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authelia_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.authelia.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authelia.ip_address
  container_name = "authelia"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-202"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # Redis - no dump needed, config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authelia"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authelia"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authelia"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  depends_on = [module.authelia]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.authelia.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.authelia.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.authelia.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = module.authelia_route.internal_url
    direct   = "http://${module.authelia.ip_address}:9091"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.authelia_route.remote_config_path
}

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for DLNA/casting)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.jellyfin}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  cores  = 4
  memory = 8192
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = 32

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Enable AMD GPU passthrough for hardware transcoding
  enable_gpu = true

  # NOTE: We don't set portainer_edge_id/key here because this app generates
  # its own .env file that includes both Jellystat and Edge credentials.
  # Setting them here would cause the docker-lxc module to create a separate
  # .env that would overwrite our combined one.

  # Mount point for media library
  # This is configured via SSH (null_resource.configure_mount_points) since
  # the API token doesn't have permission for bind mounts (requires root@pam)
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/data/library"
      volume = "/tank/data/library"
    }
  ]

  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  service_name        = "Jellyfin"
  service_description = "Media server for movies, TV shows, and music"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://jellyfin.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://jellyfin.${var.domain_public}"
    direct   = "http://${local.lan_ips.jellyfin}:8096"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Jellyfin", port = 8096, info = "Media server UI" },
    { name = "Jellyseerr", port = 5055, info = "Media request management" },
    { name = "Jellystat", port = 3000, info = "Statistics dashboard" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands
**View logs:** cd /config && docker compose logs -f jellyfin
**Restart:** cd /config && docker compose restart jellyfin
EOT

  tags = ["jellyfin", "media"]
}

module "jellyfin_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "jellyfin"
  backend_url = "http://${module.jellyfin.ip_address}:8096"

  internal_domain = "jellyfin.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "jellyfin.${var.domain_public}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.jellyfin]
}

# Jellystat - Jellyfin statistics dashboard
module "jellystat_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "jellystat"
  backend_url = "http://${module.jellyfin.ip_address}:3000"

  internal_domain = "jellystat.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Has built-in auth, only need security headers and internal access
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "internal-only"]

  depends_on = [module.jellyfin]
}

# Jellyseerr/Requests - Media request management
module "requests_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "requests"
  backend_url = "http://${module.jellyfin.ip_address}:5055"

  internal_domain = "requests.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "requests.${var.domain_public}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["public-security"]

  depends_on = [module.jellyfin]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "jellyfin_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.jellyfin.container_id
  container_ip   = module.jellyfin.ip_address
  container_name = "jellyfin"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-401"

    pre_backup_commands = [{
      name    = "PostgreSQL dump (Jellystat)"
      command = "docker exec jellystat-db pg_dump -U jellystat -d jellystat --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/jellystat-db-backup.sql.gz"
      timeout = 300
    }]

    include_paths = ["/config", "/var/lib/docker/volumes"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,jellyfin,jellystat"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["jellyfin"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["jellyfin"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  depends_on = [module.jellyfin]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" { value = module.jellyfin.container_id }
output "ip_address" { value = module.jellyfin.ip_address }
output "ssh_command" { value = module.jellyfin.ssh_command }
output "urls" {
  value = {
    jellyfin  = { internal = module.jellyfin_route.internal_url, public = module.jellyfin_route.public_url }
    jellystat = { internal = module.jellystat_route.internal_url }
    requests  = { internal = module.requests_route.internal_url, public = module.requests_route.public_url }
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Documents LXC - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 504
# IP: 10.100.5.104
#
# Document management stack:
# - Paperless-ngx: OCR, full-text search, auto-tagging, email consumption
# - Stirling-PDF: PDF manipulation (merge, split, compress, convert, etc.)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Paperless Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "paperless" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "paperless"
}

locals {
  # Flatten paperless section fields into a map by label
  _paperless_section_fields = merge([
    for s in try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.section, []) : {
      for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  paperless = {
    admin_user     = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.username, "admin")
    admin_password = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.password, "")
    db_password    = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "db_password", "")
    secret_key     = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "secret_key", "")
  }
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "documents_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Documents Stack Environment
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Paperless-ngx
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${local.paperless.admin_user}
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.admin_password}
PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.db_password}
PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${local.paperless.secret_key}

# Portainer Edge Agent
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 504
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4  # OCR is CPU intensive
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192  # OCR needs memory
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64  # Documents can grow large
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documents Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "documents"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # NOTE: Do NOT pass portainer_edge_id/key here - we handle the combined .env file
  # ourselves (including both paperless secrets AND portainer credentials).
  # The module's portainer env feature only supports portainer-only env files.

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.documents_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Documents"
  service_description = "Document management with Paperless-ngx (OCR) and Stirling-PDF (utilities)"

  service_urls = {
    paperless_internal    = "https://docs.${var.domain_internal}"
    paperless_public      = "https://docs.${var.domain_public}"
    stirling_pdf_internal = "https://pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
    stirling_pdf_public   = "https://pdf.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Paperless-ngx", port = 8000, info = "Document management with OCR" },
    { name = "Stirling-PDF", port = 8080, info = "PDF manipulation tools" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Paperless database (internal)" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Paperless cache (internal)" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f paperless
cd /config && docker compose logs -f stirling-pdf
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart paperless
cd /config && docker compose restart stirling-pdf
```

**Import documents:**
Place files in `/config/consume/` - they'll be automatically imported.

**Export all documents:**
```
cd /config && docker compose exec paperless document_exporter ../export/
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=documents` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["documents", "paperless", "pdf", "ocr"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.documents.container_id
  container_ip   = module.documents.ip_address
  container_name = "documents"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "lxc-504"

    pre_backup_commands = [{
      name    = "PostgreSQL dump (Paperless)"
      command = "docker exec paperless-db pg_dump -U paperless -d paperless --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/paperless-db-backup.sql.gz"
      timeout = 300
    }]

    include_paths = ["/config", "/var/lib/docker/volumes"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,documents,paperless"
  }

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Paperless-ngx route (internal only)
module "paperless_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "docs"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "docs.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "docs.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - Authelia protected

  type    = number

module "immich" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "immich-docker"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.photos.immich}${local.network.container_netmask}"

      path   = "/cache"

    { name = "Immich Web", port = 2283, info = "Photo management UI" },
    { name = "Immich Server", port = 2283, info = "API server" },

    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Cache" },

# =============================================================================
# Obsidian LiveSync Server - CouchDB for Obsidian note synchronization
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 503
# IP: 10.100.5.103
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module for deploying CouchDB as the sync backend.
# Accessible via Traefik at obsidian.homelab.rambtech.dev (internal) and
# obsidian.rambtech.dev (public via Cloudflare tunnel for mobile access).
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - CouchDB Credentials
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "obsidian_sync" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "obsidian-sync"
}

locals {
  # CouchDB credentials from 1Password
  couchdb_user     = data.onepassword_item.obsidian_sync.username
  couchdb_password = data.onepassword_item.obsidian_sync.password
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets
# NOTE: This file is excluded from filesync (via exclude_patterns) because
# the docker-lxc module handles .env generation for Edge credentials.
# We'll set portainer_edge_id/key to empty so the module doesn't create a separate .env,
# and we'll include both CouchDB and Edge credentials in this file instead.
resource "local_sensitive_file" "couchdb_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# CouchDB + Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# CouchDB credentials (from 1Password: obsidian-sync)
COUCHDB_USER=${local.couchdb_user}
COUCHDB_PASSWORD=${local.couchdb_password}

# Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password: portainer-edge-obsidian-sync)
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["obsidian-sync"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["obsidian-sync"].edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 503
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 1
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 1024
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 512
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 8
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Obsidian Sync Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "obsidian_sync" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "obsidian-sync"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources - CouchDB is lightweight
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # NOTE: We don't set portainer_edge_id/key here because this app
  # generates its own .env file that includes both CouchDB and Edge credentials.
  # Setting them here would cause the docker-lxc module to create a separate .env
  # that would overwrite our combined one.

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.couchdb_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Obsidian LiveSync"
  service_description = "CouchDB server for Obsidian note synchronization across devices"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://obsidian.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://obsidian.${var.domain_public}"
    couchdb  = "http://${local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync}:5984/_utils"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "CouchDB", port = 5984, info = "Database & Fauxton UI" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Obsidian LiveSync Setup

**Initialize CouchDB (first time only):**
```bash
# Run the official init script
curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vrtmrz/obsidian-livesync/main/utils/couchdb/couchdb-init.sh | bash
```

**Or manually via Fauxton UI:**
1. Open http://${local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync}:5984/_utils
2. Login with credentials from 1Password
3. Setup → Configure as Single Node
4. Create database: obsidian-vault

**Obsidian Plugin Setup:**
1. Install "Self-hosted LiveSync" plugin
2. Remote URI: https://obsidian.${var.domain_public}
3. Username/Password: from 1Password "obsidian-sync"
4. Database: obsidian-vault

## Quick Commands

```bash
cd /config && docker compose logs -f couchdb
cd /config && docker compose restart couchdb
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=obsidian-sync` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["obsidian", "sync", "couchdb", "notes"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Internal route (for homelab access)
module "obsidian_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "obsidian"
  backend_url = "http://${module.obsidian_sync.ip_address}:5984"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "obsidian.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route (via Cloudflare tunnel for mobile/remote access)
  public_domain = "obsidian.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.obsidian_sync]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.obsidian_sync.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.obsidian_sync.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.obsidian_sync.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal      = module.obsidian_route.internal_url
    public        = module.obsidian_route.public_url
    couchdb_admin = "http://${module.obsidian_sync.ip_address}:5984/_utils"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.obsidian_route.remote_config_path
}

# =============================================================================
# Monitoring LXC - OpenTelemetry + Prometheus + Grafana + Uptime Kuma + ntfy
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 500
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Observability stack for metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "OpenTelemetry-based monitoring stack with Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana      = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus   = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma  = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy         = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_otel_grpc = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317"
    direct_otel_http = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "OpenTelemetry Collector", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
    { name = "OpenTelemetry HTTP", port = 4318, info = "OTLP HTTP receiver" },
    { name = "Prometheus", port = 9090, info = "Metrics storage and alerting" },
    { name = "Grafana", port = 3000, info = "Dashboards and visualization" },
    { name = "Alertmanager", port = 9093, info = "Alert routing" },
    { name = "Uptime Kuma", port = 3001, info = "HTTP monitoring and status page" },
    { name = "ntfy", port = 8080, info = "Push notifications" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## OpenTelemetry Endpoints

**OTLP gRPC:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318

Configure Proxmox metrics server:
```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-otel \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server ${local.lan_ips.monitoring} \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

## Grafana

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

## ntfy Topics

- `homelab-alerts` - Prometheus alerts
- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

Subscribe via mobile app or web UI.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View OTEL collector logs
docker logs -f otel-collector

# Reload Prometheus config
curl -X POST http://localhost:9090/-/reload

# Test ntfy notification
curl -d "Test notification" http://localhost:8080/homelab-alerts
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=monitoring` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["monitoring", "prometheus", "grafana", "otel"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "monitoring_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    grafana_admin_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
    uptime_kuma_username   = local.op.uptime_kuma_username
    uptime_kuma_password   = local.op.uptime_kuma_password
    discord_webhook_url    = local.op.discord_webhook_url
    portainer_edge_id      = local.portainer_edge["monitoring"].edge_id
    portainer_edge_key     = local.portainer_edge["monitoring"].edge_key
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/monitoring.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "monitoring_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.monitoring_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.monitoring.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "grafana_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "grafana.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "prometheus_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prometheus"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9090"

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "alertmanager_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "alertmanager"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9093"

  internal_domain = "alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "uptime_kuma_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "status"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3001"

  internal_domain = "status.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "ntfy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ntfy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.monitoring.container_id
  container_ip   = module.monitoring.ip_address
  container_name = "monitoring"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-500"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,monitoring"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.monitoring.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.monitoring.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.monitoring.ssh_command
}

output "otel_endpoints" {
  value = {
    grpc = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4317"
    http = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4318"
  }
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.internal_url
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.internal_url
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.internal_url
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.internal_url
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.remote_config_path
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.remote_config_path
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.remote_config_path
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.remote_config_path
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Media Management LXC - Download & Library Management
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 402
# IP: 192.168.1.227
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Download clients and library managers with VPN protection.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 402
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Media Management Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "media_management" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "media-management"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.media.media_management}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for VPN TUN device access
  unprivileged = false

  # Mount data directory (for hardlinks to work)
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/data"
      volume = "/tank/data"
    }
  ]

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Media Management"
  service_description = "Download clients and library managers with VPN protection"

  service_urls = {
    qbittorrent = "https://qbittorrent.${var.domain_internal}"
    sonarr      = "https://sonarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    radarr      = "https://radarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    lidarr      = "https://lidarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    prowlarr    = "https://prowlarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    bazarr      = "https://bazarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    sabnzbd     = "https://sabnzbd.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Gluetun", port = 0, info = "VPN gateway (NordVPN WireGuard)" },
    { name = "qBittorrent", port = 8080, info = "BitTorrent client (via VPN)" },
    { name = "SABnzbd", port = 8085, info = "Usenet download client" },
    { name = "Prowlarr", port = 9696, info = "Indexer manager (via VPN)" },
    { name = "FlareSolverr", port = 8191, info = "Cloudflare bypass (via VPN)" },
    { name = "Sonarr", port = 8989, info = "TV show management" },
    { name = "Radarr", port = 7878, info = "Movie management" },
    { name = "Lidarr", port = 8686, info = "Music management" },
    { name = "Bazarr", port = 6767, info = "Subtitle management" },
    { name = "Recyclarr", port = 0, info = "TRaSH Guides sync (scheduled)" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Storage (TRaSH Guides Compliant)

**Data Directory:** `/data` (mounted from `/tank/data`)
- `/data/torrents/movies` - Movie downloads
- `/data/torrents/tv` - TV show downloads
- `/data/torrents/music` - Music downloads
- `/data/library/movies` - Movie library (hardlinks from downloads)
- `/data/library/tv` - TV show library (hardlinks from downloads)
- `/data/library/music` - Music library (hardlinks from downloads)

## VPN Protection

All torrent traffic routes through Gluetun (NordVPN WireGuard):
- qBittorrent, Prowlarr, FlareSolverr use VPN network
- Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Bazarr use host network

**Check VPN status:**
```bash
docker exec gluetun wget -qO- ifconfig.me
```

## Quick Commands

**View all logs:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose logs -f
```

**Restart VPN:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose restart gluetun
```

**Check qBittorrent connectivity:**
```bash
docker exec qbittorrent curl -s ifconfig.me
```

## TRaSH Guides Sync

Recyclarr runs on schedule to sync quality profiles:
```bash
docker exec recyclarr recyclarr sync
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=media-management` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["media", "downloads", "arr"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "qbittorrent_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "qbittorrent"
  backend_url = "http://${module.media_management.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "qbittorrent.${var.domain_internal}"

  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

module "lidarr_route" {

  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

module "prowlarr_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prowlarr"
  backend_url = "http://${module.media_management.ip_address}:9696"

  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.media_management]
}

module "bazarr_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "bazarr"
  backend_url = "http://${module.media_management.ip_address}:6767"

  internal_domain = "bazarr.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.media_management]
}

module "sabnzbd_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "sabnzbd"
  backend_url = "http://${module.media_management.ip_address}:8085"

  internal_domain = "sabnzbd.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.media_management]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "media_management_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.media_management.container_id
  container_ip   = module.media_management.ip_address
  container_name = "media-management"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-402"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]

    radarr      = module.radarr_route.internal_url
    lidarr      = module.lidarr_route.internal_url
    prowlarr    = module.prowlarr_route.internal_url
    bazarr      = module.bazarr_route.internal_url
    sabnzbd     = module.sabnzbd_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    qbittorrent = module.qbittorrent_route.remote_config_path
    sonarr      = module.sonarr_route.remote_config_path
    radarr      = module.radarr_route.remote_config_path
    lidarr      = module.lidarr_route.remote_config_path
    prowlarr    = module.prowlarr_route.remote_config_path
    bazarr      = module.bazarr_route.remote_config_path
    sabnzbd     = module.sabnzbd_route.remote_config_path

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 101
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "cloudflare_ddns_domains" {
  type    = string
  default = "homelab.rambtech.dev"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Network Services Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "network_services" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "network-services"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for DNS service)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.core.network_services}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.network_services}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Tailscale kernel access
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Network Services"
  service_description = "Core network infrastructure: DNS, tunnels, and VPN"

  service_urls = {
    adguard_internal = "https://dns.${var.domain_internal}"
    adguard_direct   = "http://${local.lan_ips.network_services}:3000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "AdGuard Home", port = 53, info = "DNS server with ad blocking" },
    { name = "AdGuard UI", port = 3000, info = "Web management interface" },
    { name = "Cloudflared", port = 0, info = "Cloudflare tunnel (outbound only)" },
    { name = "Tailscale", port = 41641, info = "Mesh VPN (systemd service)" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Tailscale Management

Tailscale runs as a systemd service (not Docker) because it requires kernel-level network access.

**Check status:**
```bash
systemctl status tailscaled
tailscale status
```

**Restart if needed:**
```bash
systemctl restart tailscaled
```

## Docker Services

**View logs:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose logs -f <service>
```

**Restart all services:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## DNS Testing

**Test AdGuard (port 53):**
```bash
dig @${local.lan_ips.network_services} google.com
```

**Test internal DNS rewrites:**
```bash
dig @${local.lan_ips.network_services} traefik.homelab.rambtech.dev
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=network-services` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["network-services", "dns", "adguard", "cloudflare"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "network_services_env" {
  content = <<-EOT
# Network Services Environment Variables
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Cloudflare Tunnel Token
CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN=${local.op.cloudflare_tunnel_token}

# Cloudflare API Token for DDNS
CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=${local.op.cloudflare_api_token}

# Domains to update with DDNS
CLOUDFLARE_DDNS_DOMAINS=${var.cloudflare_ddns_domains}

# Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password: portainer-edge-network-services)
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["network-services"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["network-services"].edge_key}
EOT

  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/network-services.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "network_services_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.network_services_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.network_services.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.network_services]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tailscale Service Management via Ansible
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ensures Tailscale daemon is running and connected after deployment

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "manage_tailscale" {
  depends_on = [module.network_services]

  # Re-run when container is rebuilt or network config changes
  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
    lan_ip       = local.lan_ips.network_services
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false  # Run ansible directly on host
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Manage Tailscale service on network-services
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        app_name: network-services

      tasks:
        # =====================================================================
        # Tailscale Service Management
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Ensure Tailscale daemon is running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: tailscaled
            state: started
            enabled: true
          register: tailscale_service

        - name: Wait for Tailscale to initialize
          ansible.builtin.pause:
            seconds: 3
          when: tailscale_service.changed

        # =====================================================================
        # Verify Tailscale Status
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check Tailscale connection status
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: tailscale status --json
          register: tailscale_status
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Parse Tailscale status
          ansible.builtin.set_fact:
            tailscale_info: "{{ tailscale_status.stdout | from_json }}"
          when: tailscale_status.rc == 0

        - name: Display Tailscale connection info
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: |
              Tailscale Status: {{ 'Connected' if (tailscale_info.BackendState | default('')) == 'Running' else 'Not Connected' }}
              Tailnet IP: {{ tailscale_info.Self.TailscaleIPs[0] | default('N/A') }}
              Hostname: {{ tailscale_info.Self.HostName | default('N/A') }}
          when: tailscale_status.rc == 0

        - name: Warn if Tailscale not connected
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: "WARNING: Tailscale is not connected. Check authentication status with 'tailscale status'"
          when: tailscale_status.rc != 0 or (tailscale_info.BackendState | default('')) != 'Running'
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "network-services" = {
          ansible_host = module.network_services.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route for AdGuard Home UI
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "adguard_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "dns"
  backend_url = "http://${module.network_services.ip_address}:3000"

  internal_domain = "dns.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = ""  # DNS admin UI should not be public

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.network_services]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "network_services_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.network_services.container_id
  container_ip   = module.network_services.ip_address
  container_name = "network-services"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-101"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,network-services"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["network-services"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["network-services"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  depends_on = [module.network_services]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.network_services.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.network_services.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.network_services.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    adguard_internal = module.adguard_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  value = module.adguard_route.remote_config_path
}

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200
#
# This deployment uses the docker-lxc module which handles:
#   1. LXC container creation with Docker pre-installed
#   2. File sync via rsync (file-sync module)
#   3. Docker Compose deployment
#   4. Proxmox notes generation
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.traefik}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # MUST be privileged for binding to ports 80/443
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude migrated routes (managed by traefik-route module) and env templates (env is generated)
  exclude_patterns = ["^migrated-dynamic/", "^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Traefik"
  service_description = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${local.traefik_ip}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "traefik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    cf_api_token = local.op.cloudflare_api_token
    cf_api_email = local.op.cloudflare_email
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/traefik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.traefik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.traefik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.traefik.ip_address
  container_name = "traefik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-200"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/config/acme.json", "/config/logs/**"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,traefik"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["traefik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["traefik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.traefik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.traefik.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.traefik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

# Get list of all files in deploy directory, excluding specified patterns
locals {
  _all_deploy_files = var.deploy_dir != "" ? fileset(var.deploy_dir, "**") : []

  # Filter out files matching exclude patterns
  deploy_files = [
    for f in local._all_deploy_files : f
    if !anytrue([for pattern in var.exclude_patterns : can(regex(pattern, f))])
  ]
}

# Sync each file individually using filesync provider
resource "filesync_file" "config_files" {
  for_each = toset(local.deploy_files)

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${each.value}"
  destination = "${var.target_path}/${each.value}"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0644"

  # SSH configuration - provider config is inherited but explicit for clarity
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc]
}

# Set custom permissions for specific files
resource "filesync_file" "custom_permissions" {
  for_each = var.file_permissions

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${trimsuffix(trimprefix(each.key, var.target_path), "/")}"
  destination = each.key
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = each.value

  # SSH configuration
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [filesync_file.config_files]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Edge Agent Environment File
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# When Edge credentials are provided, generate a .env file with the credentials.
# Docker Compose automatically loads .env files for variable substitution.
# This allows docker-compose.yml to reference ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID} and ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}

# First create the file locally (sensitive to avoid logging credentials)
resource "local_sensitive_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  filename = "${path.module}/.generated/${var.name}-portainer-edge.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu - DO NOT EDIT
# Source: 1Password item "portainer-edge-${var.name}"
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${var.portainer_edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${var.portainer_edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# Then sync to remote container as .env (Docker Compose auto-loads this)
resource "filesync_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  source      = local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env[0].filename
  destination = "${var.target_path}/.env"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0600"

  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc, local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose Deployment via Ansible
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# After filesync completes, Ansible deploys and starts the containers

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "deploy_containers" {
  depends_on = [
    filesync_file.config_files,
    filesync_file.custom_permissions,
    filesync_file.portainer_edge_env
  ]

  triggers = {
    # Use 'run' key to trigger playbook re-run when config files change
    # See: https://registry.terraform.io/providers/marshallford/ansible/latest/docs/resources/navigator_run
    run = sha256(join(",", [for f in local.deploy_files : filesha256("${var.deploy_dir}/${f}")]))
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false  # Run ansible directly on host
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Deploy Docker Compose for ${var.name}
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        config_dir: ${var.target_path}
        app_name: ${var.name}

      tasks:
        # =====================================================================
        # Verify Required Files
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check docker-compose.yml exists
          ansible.builtin.stat:
            path: "{{ config_dir }}/docker-compose.yml"
          register: compose_file

        - name: Fail if docker-compose.yml missing
          ansible.builtin.fail:
            msg: "Required file missing: docker-compose.yml"
          when: not compose_file.stat.exists

        # =====================================================================
        # Pull Images & Start Containers
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Pull container images
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: docker compose -f {{ config_dir }}/docker-compose.yml pull
            chdir: "{{ config_dir }}"
          register: pull_result
          changed_when: "'Pulled' in pull_result.stdout or 'Downloaded' in pull_result.stdout"

        - name: Start containers
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: docker compose -f {{ config_dir }}/docker-compose.yml up -d --remove-orphans
            chdir: "{{ config_dir }}"
          register: up_result
          changed_when: "'Started' in up_result.stderr or 'Creating' in up_result.stderr or 'Created' in up_result.stderr"

        # =====================================================================
        # Health Checks
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Wait for containers to stabilize
          ansible.builtin.pause:
            seconds: 10

        - name: Get container status
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: docker compose -f {{ config_dir }}/docker-compose.yml ps --format json
            chdir: "{{ config_dir }}"
          register: ps_result
          changed_when: false

        - name: Verify all containers are running
          ansible.builtin.assert:
            that:
              - ps_result.stdout | length > 0
            fail_msg: "No containers found for {{ app_name }}"
            success_msg: "Containers deployed successfully for {{ app_name }}"
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "${var.name}" = {
          ansible_host = module.lxc.container_ip
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}
